Hi Olivia — sorry for the friction here. Thanks for the screenshot, that's very helpful.

A couple quick checks and a short troubleshooting path:
1) Recurring-event edits sometimes re-publish the invite as a plain event if organizer metadata switches to an alias — can you confirm who is shown as the organizer when you open the event details?
2) If the calendar event has been programmatically updated (our scheduler or your calendar gateway), the Meet/Zoom provider metadata can be stripped. Can you hover the event and check whether the description contains a full https://meet.google.com/ or https://zoom.us/j/ link? You said you see a URL in the description — if it is a plain link it may still work, but the Join button won't render.

Immediate workaround: Ben (cc'd) can generate a temporary Zoom meeting and we'll send you an .ics to import so your calendar shows the Zoom join UI. Ben — can you create a temp Zoom host link and attach an .ics for Olivia?

I'll also open a quick ops ticket to confirm whether the recurring update changed organizer metadata on our side. If that's the case we'll republish the invite with the correct provider metadata and push an update.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
